autoshot.name: Auto Shot
autoshot.desc: Starts automatic ranged shots at the target. Toggle; not usable inside 8 yards (dead zone).

raptorstrike.name: Raptor Strike
raptorstrike.desc: Melee on-next-swing strike for extra damage.

trackbeasts.name: Track Beasts
trackbeasts.desc: Shows beasts on the minimap. One tracking at a time.

aspectofthemonkey.name: Aspect of the Monkey
aspectofthemonkey.desc: Aspect: +8% dodge. Only one Aspect at a time.

serpentsting.name: Serpent Sting
serpentsting.desc: Nature damage over 15 sec. One Sting per hunter per target. Stronger in Forever (more base damage, 5% AP per tick).

arcaneshot.name: Arcane Shot
arcaneshot.desc: Instant Arcane damage shot. No longer shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot in Forever (shares with Summon Hawk instead).

huntersmark.name: Hunter's Mark
huntersmark.desc: Marks the target: more ranged attack power against it and it stays visible. 2 min.

concussiveshot.name: Concussive Shot
concussiveshot.desc: Dazes the target, slowing it by 50% for 4 sec.

aspectofthehawk.name: Aspect of the Hawk
aspectofthehawk.desc: Aspect: more ranged attack power. Your main ranged aspect.

feedpet.name: Feed Pet
feedpet.desc: Feed your pet the selected food to raise happiness.

revivepet.name: Revive Pet
revivepet.desc: Brings your dead pet back to life (long cast).

tamebeast.name: Tame Beast
tamebeast.desc: Channel to tame a beast as your pet (20 sec, armor drops to 0).

beasttraining.name: Beast Training
beasttraining.desc: Opens the pet training window to teach abilities with Training Points.

distractingshot.name: Distracting Shot
distractingshot.desc: Ranged taunt-like shot that adds threat (pull a mob off a healer).

mendpet.name: Mend Pet
mendpet.desc: Channeled heal over time on your pet.

wingclip.name: Wing Clip
wingclip.desc: Melee hit that slows the target by 50% for 10 sec.

eyesofthebeast.name: Eyes of the Beast
eyesofthebeast.desc: Take control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min (Improved Eyes of the Beast is baseline in Forever).

scarebeast.name: Scare Beast
scarebeast.desc: Fears a beast for up to 10 sec. Damage may break it.

eagleeye.name: Eagle Eye
eagleeye.desc: Channel to zoom your view far ahead (scouting). Outdoors only.

immolationtrap.name: Immolation Trap
immolationtrap.desc: Fire trap: burns the first enemy to step on it. Traps are usable in combat in Forever; all traps share a 30 sec cooldown.

mongoosebite.name: Mongoose Bite
mongoosebite.desc: Melee counter-attack usable only after you dodge (or an Expose Prey proc).

multishot.name: Multi-Shot
multishot.desc: Shot that hits up to 3 targets. Shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot in Forever.

aimedshot.name: Aimed Shot
aimedshot.desc: Cast-time heavy shot. Baseline at 20 in Forever (was a talent); shares a cooldown with Multi-Shot.

aspectofthecheetah.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
aspectofthecheetah.desc: Aspect: +30% run speed; you are dazed if hit.

freezingtrap.name: Freezing Trap
freezingtrap.desc: Frost trap: freezes the first enemy for up to 10 sec. Your crowd control. Usable in combat in Forever.

disengage.name: Disengage
disengage.desc: Melee-range threat drop (threat reduction doubled in Forever). Stops auto-attack.

scorpidsting.name: Scorpid Sting
scorpidsting.desc: Sting that lowers the target's hit chance by 2% for 20 sec (Forever: was Strength/Agility reduction).

beastlore.name: Beast Lore
beastlore.desc: Inspect a beast: damage, health, armor, diet, abilities it can teach.

trackhidden.name: Track Hidden
trackhidden.desc: Better stealth detection and shows hidden units on the minimap.

rapidfire.name: Rapid Fire
rapidfire.desc: +40% attack speed for 15 sec. In Forever it speeds up both ranged and melee attacks.

frosttrap.name: Frost Trap
frosttrap.desc: Frost trap: creates an ice slick that slows enemies by 60%.

feigndeath.name: Feign Death
feigndeath.desc: Play dead to drop combat and threat. Can be resisted.

aspectofthebeast.name: Aspect of the Beast
aspectofthebeast.desc: Aspect: untrackable by beasts and, new in Forever, more melee attack power (trainer ranks at 40/50/60).

flare.name: Flare
flare.desc: Reveals stealthed and invisible enemies in an area for 30 sec.

explosivetrap.name: Explosive Trap
explosivetrap.desc: Fire trap: area Fire damage plus a burn to all enemies within 10 yards.

vipersting.name: Viper Sting
vipersting.desc: Sting that drains the target's mana.

aspectofthepack.name: Aspect of the Pack
aspectofthepack.desc: Aspect: +30% run speed for you and your group; anyone hit is dazed.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Channeled ground-targeted Arcane AoE for 6 sec.

aspectofthewild.name: Aspect of the Wild
aspectofthewild.desc: Aspect: Nature resistance for you and your raid in 30 yards.

tranquilizingshot.name: Tranquilizing Shot
tranquilizingshot.desc: Removes a Frenzy effect from an enemy (Molten Core book, level 60).

summonhawk.name: Summon Hawk
summonhawk.desc: New in Forever (BM tier 4, 16-point talent): instant damage and a hawk that attacks for 18 sec, up to 2 hawks. Shares a cooldown with Arcane Shot. Trainer ranks at 36/48/60.

intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.desc: Pet's next hit stuns for 3 sec and gets +100% crit chance (Forever). BM tier 5, needs Bestial Swiftness.

bestialwrath.name: Bestial Wrath
bestialwrath.desc: Pet deals 50% more damage and is immune to CC for 18 sec (BM tier 7).

trueshotaura.name: Trueshot Aura
trueshotaura.desc: Party/raid ranged attack power aura. Moved to Marksmanship tier 4 in Forever with new lower ranks (rank 2 at 32, then 40/50/60).

scattershot.name: Scatter Shot
scattershot.desc: Short-range shot that disorients for 4 sec (Marksmanship tier 5).

snipershot.name: Sniper Shot
snipershot.desc: New in Forever (Marksmanship tier 7 capstone): 4 sec cast, 45 yard long-range shot; next 3 Shots get +10 yards. Trainer ranks at 48/58.

deterrence.name: Deterrence
deterrence.desc: +25% dodge and parry for 10 sec (Survival tier 3).

counterattack.name: Counterattack
counterattack.desc: Strike usable after you parry; immobilizes for 5 sec. Survival tier 4 (16-point talent) in Forever; trainer ranks at 30/42/54.

striderkick.name: Strider Kick
striderkick.desc: New in Forever (Survival tier 5, 21-point talent): instant 100% weapon damage kick and +30% run speed for 3 sec.

petdefensive.name: Defensive
petdefensive.desc: Pet attacks what attacks you or it.

petpassive.name: Passive
petpassive.desc: Pet never attacks on its own.

petbite.name: Bite
petbite.desc: Basic damage attack (Focus). Families: Bat, Bear, Boar, Carrion Bird, Cat, Core Hound, Crocolisk, Fox, Gorilla, Hyena, Raptor, Spider, Tallstrider, Turtle, Wind Serpent, Wolf.

petclaw.name: Claw
petclaw.desc: Basic damage attack (Focus). Families: Bear, Bird of Prey, Carrion Bird, Cat, Crab, Raptor, Scorpid.

petgrowl.name: Growl
petgrowl.desc: Pet taunt; keeps mobs on the pet. Trained at the Pet Trainer (ranks every 10 levels). Families: Bat, Bear, Bird of Prey, Boar, Carrion Bird, Cat, Core Hound, Crab, Crocolisk, Fox, Gorilla, Hyena, Raptor, Scorpid, Spider, Tallstrider, Turtle, Wind Serpent, Wolf.

petcharge.name: Charge
petcharge.desc: Charges an enemy, roots it for 1 sec and buffs the next attack. Families: Boar.

petlightningbreath.name: Lightning Breath
petlightningbreath.desc: Ranged (20 yard) Nature damage. Families: Wind Serpent.

petcower.name: Cower
petcower.desc: Pet lowers its threat. Families: Bat, Bear, Bird of Prey, Boar, Carrion Bird, Cat, Core Hound, Crab, Crocolisk, Fox, Gorilla, Hyena, Raptor, Scorpid, Spider, Tallstrider, Turtle, Wind Serpent, Wolf.

petdemoralizingscreech.name: Demoralizing Screech
petdemoralizingscreech.desc: Damage plus lowers melee attack power of enemies in melee range. Renamed from Screech in Forever. Families: Carrion Bird.

petscorpidpoison.name: Scorpid Poison
petscorpidpoison.desc: Stacking Nature damage over time (up to 5 stacks). Families: Scorpid.

petmine.name: Mine!
petmine.desc: New in Forever: damage and disarms the target for 3 sec. Families: Bird of Prey.

petfurioushowl.name: Furious Howl
petfurioushowl.desc: Party melee attack power buff for 1 min. Families: Wolf.

petsonicblast.name: Sonic Blast
petsonicblast.desc: New in Forever: Nature damage and +30% spell cast time on the target for 20 sec. Families: Bat.

petswipe.name: Swipe
petswipe.desc: New in Forever: hits up to 3 nearby enemies. Families: Bear.

petpinch.name: Pinch
petpinch.desc: New in Forever: damage and 50% slow for 9 sec. Families: Crab.

petdismember.name: Dismember
petdismember.desc: New in Forever: damage and reduces healing taken by 25% for 6 sec (deep dive said 50%; tooltip says 25%). Families: Crocolisk.

pettendonrip.name: Tendon Rip
pettendonrip.desc: New in Forever: bleed and 50% slow for 9 sec. Families: Hyena.

petsavagerend.name: Savage Rend
petsavagerend.desc: New in Forever: bleed over 18 sec. Families: Raptor.

petweb.name: Web
petweb.desc: New in Forever: immobilizes the target and deals Nature damage over 4 sec. Families: Spider.

petdustcloud.name: Dust Cloud
petdustcloud.desc: New in Forever: reduces the target's armor for 30 sec. Families: Tallstrider.

pettrickstersdance.name: Trickster's Dance
pettrickstersdance.desc: New Fox family ability: pet +50% dodge and 30% faster attacks for 12 sec. Families: Fox.

petshellshield.name: Shell Shield
petshellshield.desc: Pet takes 50% less damage but attacks slower (harder hits) for 12 sec. Families: Turtle.

petdash.name: Dash
petdash.desc: Pet +40% run speed for 15 sec (ground families). Families: Bear, Boar, Cat, Crab, Crocolisk, Fox, Gorilla, Hyena, Raptor, Scorpid, Spider, Tallstrider, Turtle, Wolf.

petdive.name: Dive
petdive.desc: Pet +40% run speed for 15 sec (flying families). Families: Bat, Bird of Prey, Carrion Bird, Wind Serpent.

petprowl.name: Prowl
petprowl.desc: Pet stealth; first attack from stealth +20% damage. Families: Cat.

petthunderstomp.name: Thunderstomp
petthunderstomp.desc: Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards. Families: Gorilla.

petlavabreath.name: Lava Breath
petlavabreath.desc: Fire damage to 2 targets and slows their casting by 25%. Families: Core Hound.
